slides.label: THE MOCK EXAMPLE
lines: Meet Sample Ridge Outfitters. It isn't a real business.
We made it up so nobody gets called out. Every problem below is a fixable one.

slides.label: QUESTION 1 · IS THIS A REAL OPERATION?
items: The mock listing
3 photos. No phone number. Newest review is two years old.
The fix
Claim it. Add the phone and website. Post 10+ real photos of camp, horses and guides.

slides.label: QUESTION 2 · WHERE DO THEY HUNT?
items: The mock listing
Service area just says “Montana.” No region, no units.
The fix
List the regions you actually hunt. Set a service area, not a storefront.

slides.label: QUESTION 3 · WHAT DOES A HUNT INCLUDE?
items: The mock listing
No hunts listed. The description says “Call for details.”
The fix
List each hunt as a service: days, what's included, and a starting price if you're comfortable.

slides.label: QUESTION 4 · ARE THERE RECENT HAPPY CLIENTS?
items: The mock listing
9 reviews. None in the last two years. No replies from the owner.
The fix
Ask every hunter for a review after the hunt, with a direct link. Reply to each one.

slides.label: QUESTION 5 · HOW DO I BOOK?
items: The mock listing
The website link goes to a homepage. No dates, no deposit, no form.
The fix
Link to one page with your dates, the deposit and a simple inquiry form.

slides.label: YOUR 5-MINUTE CHECK
slides.title: Search your own business on Google
items: Is it claimed, with the right phone and website?
Are there 10+ real photos?
Is there a review from this year?
Does each hunt show what's included?
Can a hunter find how to book in one tap?

slides.label: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: Fix those five and your listing answers a hunter's questions before they ever call.
It's free, it takes an afternoon, and it works while you're guiding.
